author: Drunkturtle7
body: You need to level up your item to 10, then you can masterforge it in an alchemist building, you can also have an alchemist in your fortress if you upgrade it.

author: shuijikou
body: to add on，masterforge material cost is 300×quality（normal＝100%，ornate＝170%-200%），demonforge material cost is 666×quality
